Turn on to hear the time
Announcements follow the clock: every 15 min means :00, :15, :30 and :45.
Counted from midnight, so the times are the same every day.
Separate from your phone’s volume. It plays at this level even in silent mode.
Setup needed: allow “Alarms & reminders” so the app can speak on time.
Finish setup so Android never delays an announcement.
A soft bell just before the time is spoken
Boosts the voice beyond full volume. Can distort on small speakers.

The strongest delivery guarantee, for phones that still delay announcements. Shows an alarm icon all the time, and other apps see each announcement as your next alarm, which can end Do Not Disturb or bedtime schedules early.
Version %1$s. Every announcement is a recording made with open-source neural voices, so your phone’s built-in text-to-speech is never used.
Android limits what apps can do in the background. These steps make sure every announcement happens on time.
Lets the app wake the phone at the exact minute. Required.
Shows the next announcement, with buttons to pause or turn off.
Stops battery saving from delaying announcements. In App info, open Battery (or App battery usage) and choose Unrestricted.
Using Force stop in App info cancels announcements until you open the app again. Android applies that rule to every app.
1. Tap Open settings and switch Autostart on for Talking Clock.\n2. In App info › Battery saver, choose No restrictions.\n3. In Recents, long-press Talking Clock and tap the lock.
1. Settings › Battery › Background usage limits › Never sleeping apps: add Talking Clock.\n2. Make sure it isn’t listed under Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
1. Settings › Battery › App launch: find Talking Clock and choose Manage manually.\n2. Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
1. In App info › Battery, choose Allow background activity (or Don’t optimize).\n2. In Recents, lock Talking Clock.
1. In App info › Battery, turn on Allow background activity and Allow auto launch.\n2. In Recents, lock Talking Clock.
1. Tap Open settings and allow Talking Clock to auto-start.\n2. Settings › Battery › Background power consumption: allow Talking Clock.
1. Tap Open settings (Mobile Manager) and allow Talking Clock under Auto-start.\n2. In App info › Battery, choose Don’t optimize.
